field_principles.aggregate_row_recomputation: Row-derived aggregates catch a ready summary with one uncovered unit.
field_principles.attack_matrix: Attacks test post-hoc labels, split moves, leakage, unsupported semantics, and old-lineage reuse.
field_principles.backend_parity_rows: Z3 and exhaustive agreement prevents one solver translation from defining the labels alone.
field_principles.duration_s: Wall time detects a manifest emitted without backend enumeration and attacks.
field_principles.field_principles: A field-to-principle map prevents later reinterpretation of commitment evidence.
field_principles.field_provenance: Per-field paths, blob IDs, hashes, and reducer sources make every value traceable.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: A blocked verdict identifies the exact missing commitment or parity check.
field_principles.headroom_manifest: Predeclared candidate headroom prevents a later comparison on units where no arm can differ.
field_principles.held_isolation_receipt: Held prompts, labels, and membership must not enter development selection logic.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The verdict states whether the stream is prospectively usable without claiming any model result.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declaring exact_solver_dataset_commitment_no_llm prevents a sealed fixture from being called model evidence.
field_principles.label_commitment_receipts: Immutable receipts prove exact labels existed before model output.
field_principles.membership_commitment_receipts: Immutable receipts prove development and held membership was not chosen after results.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: Unit, backend, commitment, and attack rows allow independent replay.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Preconditions prove the exact record, target directories, and repository state were known before sealing.
field_principles.prospective_contract_ready_score: A conjunctive score blocks all model inference unless the prospective evidence boundary is valid.
field_principles.prospective_stream_manifest: A versioned manifest defines every unit, family, prompt, policy, seed, and split before inference.
field_principles.protected_clause_manifest: Protected clauses make harmful flips and safety regressions exact and replayable.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: The task must not alter exact checker authority, active roadmap, or conductor.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed seed reproduces family balancing and split membership.
field_principles.raw_output_empty_state_receipt: An empty future output path proves commitment preceded candidate generation.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: The checksum binds all unit definitions, labels, splits, exact records, and code.
field_principles.status: A terminal status distinguishes a sealed prospective contract from a partial dataset.
field_principles.tests_run: Recorded commands prove the dataset, commitment, and parity checks ran.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: The exact backends are authoritative only within the declared finite-domain semantics.
